chunks: Whoever says these words at every obligatory salat (prayer) will be protected in himself, his house, his wealth, and his children: I seek protection for myself, my wealth, my children, my family, my house, and everything that belongs to me through Allah, the One, the Unique, the Eternal Refuge, who
"He neither begets nor is born, and there is none comparable to Him."
And I seek protection for myself, my wealth, my children, my family, my house, and everything that belongs to me
"through the Lord of the Daybreak, from the evil of what He created"
to the end of it, and through "the Lord of mankind" to the end of it, and through Ayat al-Kursi to the end of it.

key_terms.الصَّمَدِ: the Eternal Refuge upon whom all depend
key_terms.بِآيَةِ الْكُرْسِيِّ: through Ayat al-Kursi, the Qur'anic verse of divine majesty and protection
key_terms.بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ: through the Lord of mankind; invoking protection from hidden evil
key_terms.بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ: through the Lord of the Daybreak; invoking divine protection

ai.seo_question: What should be recited after every obligatory prayer for protection of oneself, family, and property?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a protective supplication to be recited after every obligatory salat (prayer). It combines tawhid, Qur'anic seeking refuge through Surat al-Ikhlas, Surat al-Falaq, Surat al-Nas, and Ayat al-Kursi, and promises protection over one's self, family, home, wealth, and children.
